name: isMFAEnforcedForAdmins
definition: True when every administrator account in scope signs in with a second factor or an identity provider (a complete read of the administrators, none exempt).
population: the active administrator accounts of the connected tenant or team
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the active administrator accounts showing each one authenticates with a second factor or SSO. No administrator in the read, an error or refused answer, or a partial read is not measured.
citations: safeguards/iam/dashlane/ismfaenforcedforadmins.py (Dashlane Public API, POST /public/teams/Members: role.teamAdmin or role.billingAdmin with authentication.type sso, totp_device_registration or totp_login)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Dashlane transform can emit it.

notes: Registered so the transform named in citations can emit it. Other vendors that use the same name were not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0.
